name: home
title: Home / Kitchen
description: Cozy home kitchen and dining room with a work island, counter, fridge and real graspable tableware.

name: living_room
title: Living Room
description: Living room with sofa, coffee table, TV wall, bookshelf, rug and floor lamp; mug and speaker to pick up.

name: bedroom
title: Bedroom
description: Bedroom with quilted bed, nightstands, dresser, wardrobe and window; alarm clock on the nightstand.

name: washroom
title: Washroom
description: Family bathroom in small white tile: double vanity with mirror, bathtub, glass shower stall and toilet; towels and a laundry basket within reach.

name: living_room_loft
title: Loft Living Room
description: Industrial loft: brick walls, wood floor, L-sofa around a slab coffee table, big TV, kitchenette bar with stools and a wall of glass; speaker and mug to fetch.

name: living_room_family
title: Family Living Room
description: Warm carpeted family room: two facing sofas, toy-strewn play rug, TV and bookshelf; foam blocks and a ball for pick-up practice.

name: full_house
title: Full House (One Floor)
description: A whole 17 x 10 m single-floor home: living room, open kitchen with island, dining, bedroom, washroom and hallway — one continuous navigable space for long-horizon mobile tasks.

name: kitchen_fk
title: Franka Kitchen
description: The classic D4RL Franka Kitchen benchmark: articulated oven, microwave, cabinets and a movable kettle, rescaled for MABEL.

name: cafe
title: Corner Cafe
description: Cozy corner cafe: espresso bar with pastry case under a red awning, round tables with seated customers, window bench; a mug to bus and a pastry to deliver.

name: cafe_industrial
title: Roastery Cafe
description: Industrial roastery cafe: concrete floor, long communal tables with stools, exposed ducting, green awning and a roaster drum in the corner.

name: restaurant
title: Restaurant
description: Casual bistro: wood four-tops with seated diners, wall banquette, service bar, pendant lights — and a waiter doing rounds between the tables.

name: fastfood
title: Fast Food
description: Burger joint: checkerboard floor, glowing menu boards over the order counter, soda fountain, red booths — trays and a burger box to clear.

name: fine_dining
title: Fine Dining
description: White-tablecloth dining room: clothed rounds with candles and place settings, high-back chairs, drapes, a grand piano — and a waiter circulating silently.

name: office
title: Office
description: Office with two desk pods, monitors, chairs, filing cabinets and a whiteboard; laptop, keyboard, mouse and mug on the desks.

name: gym
title: Gym
description: Strength & cardio floor on speckled rubber: squat rack, benches, dumbbell rack, treadmills, plyo boxes and a mirror wall; kettlebell and dumbbells are real free bodies.

name: supermarket
title: Supermarket
description: Grocery store: three product aisles, produce tables with real fruit to pick, a glass cooler wall and two checkout lanes — with shoppers wandering the aisles.

name: airport
title: Airport Terminal
description: A 36 m departure concourse: check-in island, security lane, gate seating, duty-free kiosk, departure boards — travelers with roller bags criss-crossing, a jet at the glass.

name: factory
title: Factory Floor
description: Industrial hall with CNC machine, hydraulic press, pallets, shelving and a safety-striped robot cell; real tools on the workbench.

name: assembly_line
title: Assembly Line
description: A 9 m belt conveyor carrying parts, workstations with bins on both sides and an operator slot for the robot.

name: warehouse
title: Warehouse
description: Warehouse aisle between two tall pallet racks loaded with cardboard boxes; a bin and tools at picking height.

name: outdoor
title: Outdoor Park
description: Open grass field under a blue sky with a gravel path, trees, rocks and a park bench.

name: golf
title: Golf Course
description: A 40 m par-3 hole: striped fairway to a raised green with pin and real golf balls, two sand bunkers, cart path with parked cart, tee boxes and tree lines.

name: front_yard
title: Front Yard
description: Suburban front yard: house facade with porch, lawn, driveway with a parked car, picket fence, flower beds, mailbox — and a kid's ball to fetch.

name: rooftop_lounge
title: Rooftop Lounge
description: Dusk rooftop bar: glowing pool, loungers and parasols, bar counter with stools, planters, string lights and a skyline of lit facades beyond the parapet.

name: la_suburb
title: LA Hills Suburb
description: A Los Angeles hillside neighbourhood: single-family houses with pitched roofs, driveways and lawns along a palm- and plum-lined street, brown hills rising behind with the HOLLYWOOD sign, and a dog trotting the block.

name: venice_beach
title: Venice Beach
description: A California beach: soft sand down to a glittering ocean, a boardwalk lined with palms, a lifeguard tower and volleyball net, cars cruising the road behind. Sun, palms, surf.

name: city_sidewalk
title: City Sidewalk
description: A downtown block: the robot works a wide sidewalk between storefronts and a two-way street; taxis and cars circle the block, pedestrians stream both ways, lights and awnings overhead.

name: intersection
title: Busy Intersection
description: A signalized four-way crossing: alternating N-S / E-W traffic with cars braking at the stop lines, pedestrians timed to the gaps, corner shops on every quadrant. The robot owns the SW corner.

name: boulevard
title: Grand Boulevard
description: A 70 m four-lane boulevard with a planted median: a bus works its stop, cars overtake in both directions, pedestrians and a median promenade — the robot starts curbside by the bus shelter.

name: plaza
title: City Plaza
description: A pedestrian plaza around a fountain: crowds criss-crossing with pauses at the water, a coffee kiosk, benches, planters and pigeons — no cars, all people.
